'''Ruisto''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Ruisto was the first world [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the site of their initial meeting with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|scouts]]. During the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Empire [[Bombardment of Ruisto|bombarded]] Ruisto as a training exercise for its planned attack on the Mon Calamari [[Dac/Legends|homeworld]].

==Description==
Ruisto was a mostly terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] with small, high-[[Salt/Legends|saline]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="SOR" /> It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a colony of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]<ref name="RES" /><ref name="GAW" /><ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|III|114|Ruisto}}</ref> who had built small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]<ref name="RES" /><ref name="SOR" /> encircled the planet.<ref name="SOR" />

==History==
===The first colony===
[[File:Mon_Calamari_by_Chris_Scalf.jpg|left|thumb|Ruisto was the first colony of the Mon Calamari species beyond their homeworld]]
[[4500 BBY|Four and a half]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], despite their differences, the native inhabitants of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], [[Quarren–Mon Calamari War|united]] and developed unique drives to explore the surrounding space. These [[Cavitation hyperdrive|cavitation drives]] were slow, but the Mon Calamari eventually reached [[Mon Eron|Mon Eron]], the fifth planet in [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|their star system]]. As [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] began in Mon Eron's subterranean [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], the Mon Calamari left the confines of their home star system.<ref name="SOR" /> Starliners from Dac explored nearby [[Star/Legends|stars]] in relative peace, and the Mon Calamari established their first [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] worlds, such as Ruisto, [[Mantan]],<ref name="GAW" /> and [[Hinakuu]]. The Quarren grew jealous when the Mon Calamari returned with stories of their new homes, and soon began to covet settlements [[Buchich|of]] [[Minntooine/Legends|their]] [[Pammant/Legends|own]].<ref name="SOR" />

During this peaceful period of expansion, the two species avoided all contact with the wider [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Although the system had long been catalogued and surveyed by Republic [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|scouts]], it was considered one of the countless habitable worlds too far beyond the boundaries of civilized space to warrant further exploration.<ref name="GAW" /> In [[4166 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> decades after colonization efforts had begun, the Mon Calamari made first contact with Republic scouts, symbolically on their very first colony, Ruisto. As the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] rolled forward, Dac was given the opportunity to join the Republic.<ref name="SOR" />

===Prey of the Empire's wrath===
[[File:Ruisto.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Ruisto suffered the wrath of the Empire during the Galactic Civil War]]
In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="SOR" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] continued its relentless hunt for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outposts and sympathizers.<ref name="TEA" /> Meanwhile, the aged [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Therbon/Legends|Therbon]] grew frustrated with his inability to retake Mon Calamari [[Dac/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="SOR" /> which had fallen out of control during a [[Calamarian Revolt|recent revolution]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Since the Empire had been unwilling to assemble a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] large enough to assault Dac, the Mon Calamari colony on Ruisto became a suitable target for the full fury of the Empire's wrath. The Empire deployed an [[assault fleet]] composed of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to bombard Ruisto.<ref name="RES" /> Grand Moff Therbon ordered the assault fleet to conduct a sustained [[Bombardment of Ruisto|orbital bombardment]]<ref name="SOR" /> that blasted Ruisto's small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] out of existence<ref name="RES" /> and [[Mundicide|wiped out]] all life on the planet.<ref name="SOR" />

As originally intended by the Empire, the bombardment of Ruisto was meant to serve as a training exercise for its eventual attack on the Mon Calamari homeworld.<ref name="CE" /> However, the operation was never ultimately carried out and only saw [[Battle of Calamari|partial realization]] nearly [[10 ABY/Legends|ten years]] later under the leadership of [[Dark Empire|another Imperial faction]].<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>
